column1: # DOC_GATE_TRANSCRIPTS.tsv -- the transcript registry read by scripts/doc_gates.sh GATE 95 (`transcripts`).
# A transcript is a fenced block in a tracked *.md outside example/ with a `$ ` prompt line followed by
# output. Every one must have a row here, and every row must match one; the gate header in
# scripts/doc_gates.d/96_transcripts.sh has the full rules. Review-loop item Q29, leg I, 2026-10-02.
# FORMAT: file<TAB>cmd_sha12<TAB>class<TAB>evidence. cmd_sha12 is the first 12 hex digits of sha256 of
# the block's first prompt line with surrounding whitespace stripped (no line numbers, so a row does not
# move when text is added above the block). class is historical (evidence = the ISO date it was taken),
# pinned-tree (the paragraph before the fence names a commit or tag) or rerun (evidence = a tests.py
# class or a scripts/ path that re-derives the output).
# All five rows below sit in the append-only ledgers, so they are historical: the text records what
# ran then and is never reworded. HISTORY.md's rm -rf census names `main` and no sha, so it cannot be
# pinned-tree. Dates are those of the ledger section or commit that added the block.
